abstract: ABSTRACT Large ad hoc assistance programs have returned to U.S. farm policy since 2017, operating alongside a more developed safety net built around federally subsidized crop insurance, Title I commodity programs, and standing disaster assistance. This paper reviews the renewed use of ad hoc assistance, documents its recent scale using USDA data, and examines its implications for producers and policy design. Repeated ad hoc programs may create expectations of future support while leaving uncertainty about timing, eligibility, and payment formulas. They also raise questions about crop insurance incentives, targeting, transparency, taxpayer exposure, and coordination across safety‐net tools.
abstract_zh: 摘要 自2017年以来，美国农业政策中重新出现了大规模临时援助计划，这些计划与围绕联邦补贴作物保险、第一标题商品计划及常设灾害援助构建的更为完善的安全网并行运作。本文回顾了临时援助的重新启用情况，利用美国农业部数据记录了其近期规模，并探讨了其对生产者及政策设计的影响。反复实施的临时计划可能形成对未来支持的预期，同时却在时间安排、资格认定及支付公式方面留下不确定性。此外，这些计划还引发了关于作物保险激励、目标定位、透明度、纳税人风险敞口以及安全网工具间协调性的问题。
title: Temporary Programs, Lasting Questions: Ad Hoc Assistance in the U.S. Farm Safety Net
title_zh: 临时项目，持久问题：美国农业安全网中的临时援助

abstract: This paper examines how Philippine households organize their energy use in response to weather and price shocks. It develops a dual-margin framework that distinguishes between the extensive margin of energy portfolio adoption and the intensive margin of energy share allocation. The extensive margin is estimated using a multinomial probit model, while the intensive margin is estimated using a fractional multinomial logit model. Results show that mixed portfolios remain the dominant form of household energy use across income levels, locations, and electricity supply conditions. Weather shocks increase the need for energy services, but affordability and supply constraints determine whether households remain anchored in modern energy or shift towards greater reliance on traditional sources. Electricity serves as a modern energy anchor for high-income, urban, and supply-unconstrained households, while solid fuels serve as a fallback for low-income, rural, and supply-constrained households. The findings suggest that household energy transitions should not be understood as a simple movement up the energy ladder, but rather as adjustments to energy portfolios in response to weather shocks and affordability and supply reliability constraints. Thus, policies should focus on reliable, modern energy access, protection of affordability during weather- and price-related shocks, and differentiated support for vulnerable households.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了菲律宾家庭如何应对天气与价格冲击来组织其能源使用。研究构建了一个双边际分析框架，区分了能源组合采用的广延边际与能源份额分配的集约边际。广延边际采用多项概率模型进行估计，集约边际则采用分数多项逻辑模型进行估计。结果表明，混合能源组合仍是不同收入水平、地理位置和电力供应条件下家庭能源使用的主导形式。天气冲击增加了能源服务需求，但可负担性与供应约束决定了家庭是继续依赖现代能源，还是转向更多使用传统能源。电力作为高收入、城市及无供应约束家庭的现代能源锚点，而固体燃料则成为低收入、农村及供应受限家庭的备用选择。研究结论表明，家庭能源转型不应被简单理解为沿能源阶梯的线性攀升，而是家庭根据天气冲击、可负担性与供应可靠性约束对能源组合进行的动态调整。因此，政策应聚焦于可靠的现代能源接入、在天气与价格相关冲击期间保障可负担性，并对脆弱家庭提供差异化支持。
title: Beyond the energy ladder: household energy portfolios under weather and price shocks in the Philippines
title_zh: 超越能源阶梯：菲律宾天气与价格冲击下的家庭能源组合

abstract: This study examines the impact of China’s Long-Term Care Insurance (LTCI) policy on women’s entrepreneurship. Using data from the China Family Panel Studies over 2012–2020, we implement a staggered difference-in-differences design to estimate the causal effect of LTCI pilot implementation on women’s entrepreneurship. We find that LTCI significantly increases women’s likelihood of becoming entrepreneurs, with larger effects among households with lower wealth and those in which older family members are in poorer health. lowering young women’s perceived exposure to future risks and easing the caregiving demands they face within the family, thereby strengthening both their willingness and ability to engage in entrepreneurial activity. We further explore spillover effects on intrahousehold allocation and intergenerational outcomes. LTCI not only promotes women’s entrepreneurship but also narrows gender income disparities and improves children’s cognitive and non-cognitive development. Overall, our findings provide policy-relevant evidence for strengthening long-term care institutions and for designing complementary policies that advance women’s economic participation and gender equality.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了中国长期护理保险政策对女性创业的影响。基于2012-2020年中国家庭追踪调查数据，我们采用交错双重差分法估计长期护理保险试点实施对女性创业的因果效应。研究发现，长期护理保险显著提升了女性成为创业者的概率，这一效应在低财富家庭及家中老年成员健康状况较差的群体中更为显著。该政策通过降低年轻女性对未来风险的感知暴露度、缓解其家庭照护负担，从而增强了她们参与创业活动的意愿与能力。我们进一步探讨了该政策对家庭内部资源配置及代际结果的溢出效应：长期护理保险不仅促进了女性创业，还缩小了性别收入差距，并改善了子女的认知与非认知能力发展。总体而言，本研究为完善长期照护制度、设计促进女性经济参与及性别平等的配套政策提供了具有政策参考价值的实证依据。

title: Hidden support: long-term care insurance and women’s entrepreneurship
title_zh: 隐性支持：长期护理保险与女性创业

abstract: Abstract Using existing and new price data sets, we provide the first estimates of market integration across England over the entire 200 years of the industrial revolution. We document a significant, though not huge, integration improvement for markets furthest from London. Full integration was achieved by the 1830s. Our price data sets vary in quality (type of average, price rounding, frequency of stale prices). We show that this severely biases some standard statistical tests of market integration, and we develop and implement new techniques to ensure valid inference. We discuss the application of these techniques to other historical data sets.
abstract_zh: 摘要 利用现有及新增的价格数据集，我们首次估算了工业革命整个200年间英格兰市场的整合程度。研究发现，距离伦敦最远的市场在整合方面取得了显著（尽管并非巨大）的改善。到19世纪30年代，市场已实现完全整合。我们的价格数据集在质量上存在差异（包括平均值类型、价格取整、陈旧价格频率）。我们证明，这些差异严重扭曲了某些市场整合的标准统计检验，并开发并实施了新技术以确保推断的有效性。我们还讨论了这些技术在其他历史数据集中的应用。
title: The big impact of small change: Fresh estimates of English wheat market integration, 1693–1893
title_zh: 小变化的巨大影响：英国小麦市场整合的新估计，1693–1893

abstract: Abstract Richard Musgrave et al.’s “Distribution of Tax Payments by Income Groups” (1951) provided the first postwar estimates of the distribution of the fiscal burden, concluding the tax system was not as progressive as statutory rates suggested. Drawing from original archival material, we reconstruct the intellectual context of Musgrave’s study, the methodological debates it gave rise to, and assess its legacy in public finance. The study’s legacy is examined through the rise of econometric estimation, applied general equilibrium modeling, and microdata-based approaches, as well as its influence on policy institutions in the USA and abroad. Despite major advances in data and modeling, we argue that key issues raised by Musgrave—particularly the definition of the income basis and the incidence of the corporate income tax—remain unresolved. The enduring lack of consensus on a uniquely best method highlights both the empirical and normative challenges at the heart of distributional analysis and explains the study’s continued relevance in contemporary debates on taxation and income inequality.
abstract_zh: 理查德·马斯格雷夫等人于1951年发表的《按收入群体划分的税收负担分配》提供了战后首批财政负担分配估算，结论表明税收制度并未如法定税率所示那般具有累进性。基于原始档案材料，我们重构了马斯格雷夫研究的学术背景、由此引发的方法论争论，并评估了其在公共财政领域的学术遗产。通过计量经济学估计、应用一般均衡建模、基于微观数据的方法的兴起，以及该研究对美国及海外政策机构的影响，我们审视了其学术遗产。尽管数据与建模技术取得重大进展，我们认为马斯格雷夫提出的关键问题——特别是收入基础的定义与企业所得税的归宿——仍未得到解决。对唯一最优方法长期缺乏共识，凸显了分配分析核心的经验与规范挑战，也解释了该研究在当代税收与收入不平等辩论中持续具有相关性的原因。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: On the 75th anniversary of Musgrave’s distribution of tax payments by income groups
title_zh: 穆斯卡夫按收入群体划分税收负担分配理论75周年纪念

publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Credit and inventories in illiquid housing markets
title_zh: 流动性不足的住房市场中的信贷与库存

abstract: Abstract The well-known cashless-limiting result in Woodford (1998) has become the theoretical foundation for a large body of work that treats the costs and benefits of holding money as irrelevant for monetary transmission. I reexamine this result and find that it relies on a peculiar credit-market structure consisting of perfectly competitive, zero-interest deferred payment arrangements. I show that the result breaks down when the microstructure is generalized to allow for an endogenous interest rate and market power in credit intermediation. The tenuousness of this influential result should give pause to the widespread practice of basing monetary policy advice on models without money.
abstract_zh: 摘要 伍德福德（1998）中著名的无现金限制性结论已成为大量研究的理论基础，这些研究将持有货币的成本与收益视为与货币政策传导无关。本文重新审视了这一结论，发现其依赖于一种特殊的信贷市场结构，即完全竞争、零利率的延期支付安排。研究表明，当微观结构被推广至允许内生利率和信贷中介市场势力时，该结论不再成立。这一具有影响力的结论的脆弱性，应当让广泛基于无货币模型提供货币政策建议的做法有所反思。
title:
onetary Economics
                    at 30: A Reexamination of the Relevance of Money in Cashless Limiting Monetary Economies
title_zh: 货币经济学30年：无现金极限货币经济中货币相关性的再审视

abstract: Abstract I propose a model of skill-replacing routine-biased technological change (SR-RBTC). In this model, technology substitutes for the use of skill in routine tasks, in contrast to standard RBTC models, which assume that technology replaces the workers themselves. The SR-RBTC model explains three key trends that are inconsistent with standard RBTC models: 1) why specifically middle wages declined even though workers in routine occupations are dispersed across the entire bottom half of the wage distribution, 2) why middle wages stopped declining while technological change continued, and 3) why there is no substantial decline in the average wage of workers in routine occupations. I derive two new testable predictions from the model: a decrease in the return to skill and a decrease in skill level in routine occupations. I use an interactive fixed-effects model to confirm both predictions. Since SR-RBTC violates the ignorability assumption required by standard decomposition methods, I introduce a “skewness decomposition” to show that SR-RBTC is the main driver of bottom-half inequality trends.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文提出了一种技能替代型常规偏向技术变革（SR-RBTC）模型。在该模型中，技术替代了常规任务中的技能使用，这与标准RBTC模型（假设技术替代工人本身）形成对比。SR-RBTC模型解释了与标准RBTC模型不一致的三个关键趋势：1）尽管常规职业中的工人分散于整个工资分布下半部分，但为何中位数工资却出现下降；2）为何在技术变革持续进行的情况下，中位数工资停止下降；3）为何常规职业工人的平均工资未出现显著下降。基于该模型，我推导出两个可检验的新预测：常规职业中技能回报率下降以及技能水平下降。通过交互固定效应模型，我验证了这两个预测。由于SR-RBTC违反了标准分解方法所需的可忽略性假设，我引入了一种“偏度分解”方法，证明SR-RBTC是下半部分工资不平等趋势的主要驱动因素。
title: Skill-Replacing Technology and Bottom-Half Inequality
title_zh: 技能替代型技术与底层收入不平等

abstract: The paper develops a new monetarist DSGE model to examine the macroeconomic implications of fiat-money-backed stablecoins and the effectiveness of prudential policies in mitigating associated risks. The model features two segmented sectors: a centralized real economy where fiat money facilitates consumption and investment, and a decentralized virtual economy characterized by anonymous bilateral search and matching, in which transactions are exclusively conducted using stablecoins. Calibrated to the U.S. economy, the simulation results reveal that stablecoins amplify the propagation of exogenous shocks to key macroeconomic variables by weakening the effectiveness of monetary policy. However, prudential regulations—specifically those governing the backing ratio of stablecoins to fiat-denominated reserve assets, analogous to banking liquidity requirements—can serve as stabilizing instruments, dampening volatility and enhancing macroeconomic resilience in the presence of stablecoins.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个新型货币主义DSGE模型，以研究由法定货币支持的稳定币的宏观经济影响，以及审慎政策在缓解相关风险方面的有效性。该模型包含两个分割的部门：一个集中的实体经济部门，其中法定货币促进消费和投资；一个去中心化的虚拟经济部门，其特征是匿名双边搜索与匹配，交易仅使用稳定币进行。基于美国经济数据的校准模拟结果显示，稳定币通过削弱货币政策的有效性，放大了外生冲击对关键宏观经济变量的传导效应。然而，审慎监管——特别是针对稳定币与法定计价储备资产支持比率的监管（类似于银行流动性要求）——可作为稳定工具，在存在稳定币的情况下抑制波动性并增强宏观经济韧性。
authors: Hui He & Yao Zhao & Dayong Zhou
title: Stablecoins and Macroeconomic Stability: A DSGE Investigation
title_zh: 稳定币与宏观经济稳定性：一项DSGE研究

abstract: Climate disasters tend to be associated with increased sovereign default risk. Countries face an “impossible trilemma”: scale up adaptation investment, keep debt sustainable amidst high borrowing costs and avoid the higher risk of default from delayed adaptation. Using a global panel of disaster event-level shocks, we find that a 1pp increase in disaster related losses as a share of GDP raises the odds of sovereign default by approximately 2-3 percent. An additional US$1 billion in cumulative Official Development Assistance (ODA) is associated with a 0.13 point gain in a country’s adaptive capacity. Using average marginal effects and our predicted margins we then map concessional ODA finance to default probability and translate these relationships into a practical budgeting yardstick for calibrating needed ODA to sovereign default risk reduction targets. In a context of declining ODA, our findings highlight the crucial role of well-designed support in climate adaptation policies.
abstract_zh: 气候灾害往往与主权违约风险上升相关。各国面临一个"不可能三角"：扩大适应投资规模、在高借贷成本下维持债务可持续性、以及避免因延迟适应而导致的更高违约风险。基于全球灾害事件冲击层面的面板数据，我们发现灾害相关损失占GDP比重每增加1个百分点，主权违约概率将上升约2-3%。累计官方发展援助每增加10亿美元，与一国适应能力提升0.13个点相关。通过运用平均边际效应与预测边际值，我们将优惠性官方发展援助资金映射至违约概率，并将这些关系转化为实用的预算标尺，用于校准实现主权违约风险降低目标所需的官方发展援助。在官方发展援助持续缩减的背景下，我们的研究凸显了精心设计的支持在气候适应政策中的关键作用。
authors: Constance de Soyres & Emmanuella Obeng & Joanne Tan
title: Climate Shocks, Debt Defaults and Investment in Climate Adaptation – Squaring an Impossible Trilemma
title_zh: 气候冲击、债务违约与气候适应投资——破解不可能三角

abstract: Firm-level geoeconomic risk can affect even broadly diversified mutual fund portfolios. We study U.S. export controls that restrict sales of cutting-edge technology to selected Chinese firms for national security reasons. The stock prices of affected domestic suppliers drop immediately after the policy introduction. Mutual funds holding these stocks experience increased volatility and lower returns. Fund managers respond by selling stocks of exporters to China, buying lottery-like stocks, and increasing portfolio concentration. While stock-picking and market-timing skills do not help, specialist and high-fee funds are better at navigating geoeconomic risk.
abstract_zh: 企业层面的地缘经济风险甚至可能影响广泛分散化的共同基金投资组合。本文研究美国出于国家安全原因限制向特定中国企业销售尖端技术的出口管制政策。受政策影响的国内供应商股价在政策出台后立即下跌。持有这些股票的共同基金面临波动性上升和回报率下降。基金经理通过抛售对华出口企业股票、购买彩票型股票以及提高投资组合集中度来应对。虽然选股能力和择时能力无助于应对风险，但专业型基金和高费率基金在规避地缘经济风险方面表现更优。
authors: Matteo Crosignani; Lina Han; Marco Macchiavelli

title: Navigating Geopolitical Risk: Evidence from U.S. Mutual Funds
title_zh: 驾驭地缘政治风险：来自美国共同基金的证据

abstract: We analyze consumer surplus when a monopolist can adjust both prices and product qualities across segments, engaging in second- and third-degree price discrimination simultaneously. We characterize the consumer-optimal segmentation and show that it has a striking structure: consumers with the same value receive the same quality in every segment, though prices differ. Under mild conditions, any segmentation harms consumers if and only if demand is sufficiently more elastic than supply. Hence, potential benefits for consumers depend critically on demand and supply elasticities. These findings have implications for regulatory policy regarding price discrimination and market segmentation.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了垄断者在不同细分市场中同时调整价格与产品质量、实施二级与三级价格歧视时的消费者剩余。我们刻画了消费者最优细分结构，并揭示其具有显著特征：在每一细分市场中，具有相同价值的消费者获得相同质量，但价格存在差异。在温和条件下，当且仅当需求弹性显著大于供给弹性时，任何细分都会损害消费者利益。因此，消费者潜在收益关键取决于需求与供给弹性。这些发现对价格歧视与市场细分的监管政策具有启示意义。
authors: Dirk Bergemann; Tibor Heumann; Michael Wang
title: Screening and Segmenting: A Consumer Surplus Perspective
title_zh: 筛选与细分：消费者剩余视角

abstract: We use a randomized controlled trial to examine how out-of-pocket costs affect contraceptive method choice, pregnancy, abortion, and childbirth among uninsured U.S. women. The study recruited women seeking care through Title X—a national family planning program subsidizing reproductive health services for low-income Americans—and randomized vouchers, making the full spectrum of contraception highly discounted or free. We find that subsidizing contraception has large and persistent effects on the choice of con- traceptive method, resulting in significantly fewer pregnancies and abortions at 26 months. The effects on births are inconclusive.
abstract_zh: 我们通过一项随机对照试验，考察自付费用如何影响美国无保险女性的避孕方法选择、怀孕、堕胎及分娩。研究招募了通过Title X（一项为低收入美国人提供生殖健康服务补贴的国家计划生育项目）寻求医疗服务的女性，并随机发放代金券，使各类避孕措施大幅降价或免费。我们发现，补贴避孕措施对避孕方法的选择产生了显著且持续的影响，在26个月时导致怀孕和堕胎数量显著减少。对分娩的影响尚无定论。
authors: Martha J. Bailey; Emilia Brito; Deniz Gorgulu; Kelsey Figone; Vanessa Wanner Lang; Alexa Prettyman; Vanessa K. Dalton
title: Does Increasing Financial Access to Contraception in the U.S. Reduce Unintended Pregnancies? Evidence from the M-CARES Randomized Control Trial at Two Years
title_zh: 美国增加避孕药具的经济可及性是否能减少意外怀孕？来自M-CARES两年随机对照试验的证据

abstract: How does informality shape the impact of minimum wage policy? We study this question using evidence from Mexico’s 145% real increase in the minimum wage since 2016, together with a general equilibrium model featuring endogenous informality and household heterogeneity. Reduced-form estimates of the implemented increases indicate limited effects on employment and formalization, alongside modest wage gains at the bottom of the formal wage distribution that arguably reflect incomplete enforcement. The calibrated model reproduces these patterns but predicts that, under full enforcement, higher wage floors generate nonlinear effects: the share of firms reallocating toward informality rises sharply, lowering productivity and aggregate welfare. These losses fall disproportionately on low-skill households, who bear the brunt of the reduction in transfers caused by lower tax revenue yet, as predominantly informal workers, gain little directly from the minimum wage. The minimum wage’s effectiveness as a redistributive tool is therefore limited.
abstract_zh: 非正规性如何影响最低工资政策的效果？我们利用墨西哥自2016年以来最低工资实际增长145%的证据，结合包含内生非正规性与家庭异质性的一般均衡模型来研究这一问题。对已实施最低工资上调的简化形式估计表明，其对就业和正规化的影响有限，同时正规工资分布底端出现温和的工资增长——这在一定程度上反映了执法不完善。校准后的模型复现了这些特征，但预测在完全执法条件下，更高的工资下限会产生非线性效应：转向非正规部门的企业比例急剧上升，从而降低生产率和总体福利。这些损失不成比例地由低技能家庭承担——他们因税收减少导致的转移支付下降而首当其冲，但作为以非正规就业为主的劳动者，却几乎无法直接从最低工资中获益。因此，最低工资作为再分配工具的有效性十分有限。

title: Minimum Wages and the Informality Constraint

abstract: In a series of declarations throughout 2025 and into 2026, the United States announced higher tariffs on nearly all imports from most countries. The countries that make up the CAPDR region (Costa Rica, Dominican Republic, Guatemala, Honduras, Nicaragua, Panama and El Salvador) are affected through sizeable direct trade linkages with the United States, and through indirect trade linkages with third countries. This paper explores the potential long-term economic effects of these tariff increases on CAPDR using a multi-region multi-industry model of the global economy. The modelling exercises suggest that CAPDR member countries will experience falls in real GDP to varying degrees, with the severity of the effect closely linked to direct export exposure to the United States. The most vulnerable industries are heavily trade-exposed manufactures, although exemptions – most importantly for textiles & apparel – may provide some scope for trade diversion to offset some of the GDP losses. Although ongoing legal challenges have introduced additional uncertainty regarding the ultimate extent of tariff changes, the results in this paper will remain broadly valid providing the tariffs remain in place.
abstract_zh: 在2025年至2026年的一系列声明中，美国宣布对来自大多数国家的几乎所有进口商品加征更高关税。中美洲-多米尼加共和国地区（CAPDR）成员国（哥斯达黎加、多米尼加共和国、危地马拉、洪都拉斯、尼加拉瓜、巴拿马和萨尔瓦多）通过与美国直接且规模可观的贸易联系，以及与第三国的间接贸易联系而受到影响。本文运用全球经济多区域多产业模型，探讨了这些关税上调对CAPDR的潜在长期经济影响。模型测算表明，CAPDR成员国实际GDP将出现不同程度的下降，其影响严重程度与对美国的直接出口敞口密切相关。最脆弱的行业是高度依赖贸易的制造业，尽管豁免条款——最重要的是纺织品与服装——可能通过贸易转移在一定程度上抵消部分GDP损失。尽管持续的法律挑战为关税变动的最终幅度增添了额外不确定性，但只要关税措施持续实施，本文的研究结果将基本保持有效。

abstract: Housing affordability is high on the economic, social, and political agenda in Europe. While the economic literature has mostly analyzed the drivers of housing unaffordability, this paper focuses on its consequences, quantifying, at the EU level, its impact on individuals’ well-being as well as its economic and demographic impact. We find that the impact of an increase in housing cost burden is large on housing adequacy as well as on poverty and health. It is somewhat smaller on fertility and labor force participation.

abstract: Short-term reversal appears to have weakened in international equity markets because standard measures mix firm-specific and industry-wide returns. When evaluated relative to industry peers, the reversal persists. Using data from 64 countries, the conventional strategy delivers negligible returns, whereas an industry-adjusted strategy earns 0.53% per month with a Sharpe ratio of 0.74. The effect reflects the reversal of firm-specific shocks masked by persistent industry components. A regret-based signal captures the same industry-relative variation, adding no incremental return. Reversal did not disappear; it was mismeasured.
abstract_zh: 短期反转效应在国际股票市场中似乎有所减弱，这是因为标准指标混淆了公司特定回报与行业整体回报。当以行业同行作为基准进行评估时，反转效应依然存在。基于64个国家的数据，传统策略带来的回报微乎其微，而经行业调整后的策略每月可获得0.53%的收益，夏普比率为0.74。这一效应反映了被持续性行业成分掩盖的公司特定冲击的反转。基于遗憾的信号捕捉到了相同的行业相对变化，但并未带来额外回报。反转效应并未消失，而是被错误衡量了。
title: Short-Term Reversal Persists Globally—If Properly Measured
